answer: Back each agent identity with a refundable $5 card-verified deposit. The agent links a card, a $5 hold goes on it, and the card network's fingerprint ties that card to one identity only. The deposit locks 30 days; clean behavior releases it. Duplicates are rejected at the door; a sybil cluster that slips through forfeits all deposits and gets blacklisted. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $5,000 locked plus $20 to $40 per stolen card. Honest agents wander in, get their money back. A sybil farmer hits a ferrous wall at the vertex where identity meets money, because every fake passport costs cash.
